fusions.name: Root Ball
fusions.desc: Throws a root-bound clod that deals 6 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. It holds 5 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Knotted Runners
fusions.desc: Knots the roots under up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 5 seconds. It deals 10 damage to each and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Wattle Hurdle
fusions.desc: Weaves a wattle fence 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Strands in the Daub
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (35% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
